title: Gas buffer settings accept values that remove their protection: a negative per-chain buffer and multipliers below 1

evidence.note: buffer read with no sign check
parseEther(gasBuffer) is added to the floor
multipliers accept any finite positive value

evidence.ref: node -e parseEther("-0.1") using the repo ethers (22-27 merge)
evidence.note: Claude verification: returns -100000000000000000n, so a negative buffer lowers the floor.

sibling_sites_checked: EXIT_GATE_SELL_GAS_BUFFER and DELIBERATE_BUY_GAS_BUFFER both use the same parser pattern; AUD-DB-001 lists the other malformed-setting cases.
severity_rationale: S3: an unusual operator setting (a negative value or a multiplier under 1) with no typo path of the kind AUD-DB-001 has.
recommendation: Reject negative buffers and multipliers below 1 at load, in the env contract of card DB-06. Phase 29 (S2-S4). Nothing is fixed in Phase 22 (NAC-13).
